answer_1.quote: We investigate how LLMs can support STRICTA, by testing their abilities on the collected dataset.

answer_2.quote: We assess LLM outputs using automatic text similarity metrics to measure alignment with human answers across multiple dimensions.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a pilot study with human evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess whether each predicted fact is implied by one, multiple, or none of the original facts.
